info.sub_ename: SEMINAR ON SUSTAINABLE DEVELOPMENT AND MANAGEMENT

description.sub_ename: SEMINAR ON SUSTAINABLE DEVELOPMENT AND MANAGEMENT
description.describe_ch:
企業社會責任的三重基線對於企業的永續經營越來越重要，相關的企業需求可以表現在實務上一些認證的形式中！因此這一個課程的目標就在於討論相關的認證機制，涵蓋所有相關利害關係人領域的課題，
因此課程中將邀請環境、勞工、社區方面的專家參與！
description.describe_eh: The objective of this course is to introduce why the business ethics and social responsibility are important today and to further the definition of the role that managers play in promoting excellence in both areas. Following two sections introduce both the ethics principles and standards and the social responsibility principles to provide a base for comparison throughout the rest of this proceedings.

targets.describe_ch:
企業永續報告是未來聯合國進行全球永續發展目標管理的核心事務，
也是企業推升績效與因應永續危機的基礎工作，本課程將帶領學生從實做中認識全球永續發展
targets.describe_en: Corporate Sustainability Report (CSR) is the core affair of The United Nations by managing  Sustainability Development Goals (SDGs). It’s not only the basement of corporate performance presentation, but also that of risk prevention. The course will lead the students to know the global sustainability development through making a rough CSR.
